content: copy-marked: another way to integrate copies without having to deal with OOVs is to augment the source vocabulary with a copy of the target vocabulary. In this setup, BIBREF25 ensure that both vocabularies never overlap by marking the target word copies with a special language identifier. Therefore the English word resume cannot be confused with the homographic French word, which is marked @fr@resume.
